text: キングズムーアFCは65分、2対3で負けている中で攻め方を変えました。守備の圧力を高めて、ボールを奪いに行く距離を増やし、より直接的に攻撃するようにしましたが、この間にボール支配率は57.6%から51.6%に下がり、チャンスの期待度（xG）も0.05から0に下がっています。[#1187] これは、相手陣内でのボールのミスが増えたものの、まだゴールを決められていないことを示しています。攻撃的なプレーで流れを変えようとしていますが、すぐには得点に結びついていません。[#1187]

- Kingsmoor FC increased their press from 0.5 to 0.68 at 65' to chase the game [#1187].
- They also raised directness from 0.5 to 0.65 and line height from 0.5 to 0.62 in the same tactical change [#1187].
- Before the change, Kingsmoor FC had xG 0.05 and possession 57.6%; after, xG dropped to 0 and possession to 51.6% [#1187].
- High turnovers doubled from 2 to 4 after the change, with shots decreasing from 1 to 0 [#1187].
- Score remained Kingsmoor FC 2, Westport Albion 3 at the time of the tactical adjustment [#1187].

- Kingsmoor FC, trailing 2-3 at 65', adjusted their tactics to press higher up the pitch and play more direct, evidenced by increases in pressing intensity (press from 0.5 to 0.68), directness (0.5 to 0.65), and defensive line height (0.5 to 0.62), aiming to quickly recover the ball and exploit vertical transitions [#1187].
- This tactical shift reflects Kingsmoor's 4-4-2 formation focusing on wide crossing play under coach Pablo Iriarte, increasing high turnovers (from 2 to 4) and box touches (10 to 12) to create more attacking presence in the opponents’ penalty area, although it slightly reduced possession (57.6% to 51.6%) and expected goals (xG from 0.05 to 0) [#1187].
- Meanwhile, Westport Albion, also in a 4-4-2 with a direct and vertical passing style, saw their opponent's pressing intensity increase but maintained a relatively strong counter-press (ppda decreased slightly from 8.0 to 7.6), and their own xG decreased slightly from 0.74 to 0.63, indicating some disruption but sustaining defensive resilience [#1187].
- Overall, Kingsmoor's tactical change to a higher press and more direct play intended to create overloads and quick attacking transitions in line with their crossing style, but results show limited immediate impact on scoring chances in this phase.
